dsi:facet/step: The absolute position of a token within one scale, as its product numbers it; comparable only within that scale.
dsi:facet/hue: The named hue of a member of a categorical color set, where the hue itself carries the meaning.
dsi:facet/style: The motion or type character a token belongs to: quick and utilitarian, or larger and more noticeable.
dsi:domain/color: Token values that set the color of interface elements, including fills, text, icons, borders and shadows.
dsi:domain/typography: Token values that set how text looks: font family, size, weight, line height, letter spacing and composed type styles.
dsi:domain/opacity: Token values that set how transparent an element or layer is, from fully transparent to fully opaque.
dsi:emphasis/subtlest: The weakest step of an emphasis family that has more than three steps.
dsi:emphasis/subtler: The step between subtlest and subtle in an emphasis family.
dsi:emphasis/subtle: A step weaker than the default, contrasting less with the page than the default member of its family.
dsi:emphasis/strong: A step stronger than the default, contrasting more with the page than the default member of its family.
dsi:emphasis/stronger: The step between strong and strongest in an emphasis family.
dsi:emphasis/strongest: The strongest step of an emphasis family that has more than three steps.
dsi:usage/categorical: A set of distinct colors assigned to identities or series, where each member is a different color, not a level.
dsi:usage/data-viz: Marks in charts and graphs, such as series colors and chart status colors.
dsi:usage/code-surface: The surfaces of code blocks and editors: background, gutter, line numbers, highlighted lines and diff lines.
dsi:usage/on-fill: Content placed on a filled background, where it must contrast with that fill.
dsi:property/icon: The color or size of icons and other small symbolic graphics.
dsi:property/focus-ring: The outline drawn around an element that has keyboard focus.
dsi:property/shadow: The shadow cast by an element to show its elevation above the surface behind it.
dsi:property/corner-shape: A set of four corner radii that rounds only some corners of an element.
dsi:component/button: A control that starts an action when the user activates it.
dsi:component/button-group: A set of related buttons laid out together as one control.
dsi:component/card: A container that groups content and actions about one subject on its own surface.
dsi:component/text-field: A single-line text input with its label and supporting text.
dsi:component/table: A grid of rows and columns that presents structured data.
dsi:part/indicator: A line or mark that shows the state of its component.
dsi:part/cell: One intersection of a row and a column in a table.
dsi:state/hover: The state of an element while a pointer rests over it.
dsi:state/active: The state of an element while it is being pressed.
dsi:state/focus: The state of an element while it receives keyboard or programmatic input.
dsi:state/disabled: The state of an element that is shown but cannot be used.
dsi:state/selected: The state of an element that the user has chosen from a set.
dsi:state/dragged: The state of an element while the user drags it.
dsi:mode/light: The theme with light surfaces and dark content.
dsi:mode/dark: The theme with dark surfaces and light content.
dsi:mode/expressive: A theme variant with stronger color, shape and motion for more noticeable interfaces.
dsi:mode/increased-contrast: A theme variant that raises contrast between content and surfaces for users who need it.
dsi:syntax/comment: Text in source code that explains it and does not run.
dsi:syntax/line-comment: A comment that ends at the end of its line.
dsi:syntax/block-comment: A comment enclosed by start and end markers, which may span several lines.
dsi:syntax/doc-comment: A comment that documents the code element that follows it.
dsi:syntax/name: An identifier of any kind in source code.
dsi:syntax/tag-name: The name of a markup tag, a kind of type name.
dsi:syntax/property-name: The name of a property or field of an object.
dsi:syntax/attribute-name: The name of a markup attribute, a kind of property name.
dsi:syntax/label-name: The name of a label that a jump or loop statement can target.
dsi:syntax/namespace: The name of a namespace or module path.
dsi:syntax/literal: A value written directly in source code.
dsi:syntax/doc-string: A string that documents the code element it belongs to.
dsi:syntax/character: A literal single character, a kind of string.
dsi:syntax/attribute-value: The value of a markup attribute, a kind of string.
dsi:syntax/bool: A literal true or false value.
dsi:syntax/escape: A literal escape sequence, such as a backslash escape inside a string.
dsi:syntax/color: A literal color value, such as a hex color in a style sheet.
dsi:syntax/keyword: A word reserved by the language.
dsi:syntax/self: The keyword that refers to the current object.
dsi:syntax/null: The keyword for the absence of a value.
dsi:syntax/atom: A keyword that denotes an atomic value.
dsi:syntax/unit: A keyword for a unit of measure, such as px or em.
dsi:syntax/modifier: A keyword that modifies a declaration, such as static or public.
dsi:syntax/operator-keyword: A keyword that acts as an operator, such as typeof or in.
dsi:syntax/control-keyword: A keyword that controls flow, such as if, for or return.
dsi:syntax/definition-keyword: A keyword that defines something, such as let, function or class.
dsi:syntax/module-keyword: A keyword for defining or using modules, such as import or export.
dsi:syntax/operator: A symbol that performs an operation on its operands.
dsi:syntax/deref-operator: An operator that dereferences a value or accesses a member.
dsi:syntax/arithmetic-operator: An operator for arithmetic, such as plus or times.
dsi:syntax/logic-operator: An operator for logic, such as and, or, or not.
dsi:syntax/bitwise-operator: An operator that works on the bits of its operands.
dsi:syntax/compare-operator: An operator that compares its operands.
dsi:syntax/update-operator: An operator that changes its operand, such as an increment or assignment.
dsi:syntax/definition-operator: An operator that defines something, such as the colon in a declaration.
dsi:syntax/type-operator: An operator that works on types.
dsi:syntax/control-operator: An operator that controls flow, such as the conditional operator.
dsi:syntax/punctuation: A punctuation mark in code or markup.
dsi:syntax/separator: Punctuation that separates items, such as a comma or semicolon.
dsi:syntax/bracket: Punctuation that opens or closes a group.
dsi:syntax/angle-bracket: An angle bracket, usually less-than or greater-than.
dsi:syntax/content: Prose content in a markup document, such as plain text.
dsi:syntax/content-separator: A separator between blocks of prose content, such as a horizontal rule.
dsi:syntax/emphasis: Content styled with emphasis, usually italic.
dsi:syntax/link: Content that is part of a link.
dsi:syntax/monospace: Content styled as code or monospace text.
dsi:syntax/strikethrough: Content styled with a line through it.
dsi:syntax/inserted: Text added in a change-tracking format, such as a diff.
dsi:syntax/deleted: Text removed in a change-tracking format, such as a diff.
dsi:syntax/changed: Text modified in a change-tracking format, such as a diff.
dsi:syntax/invalid: An element that is invalid or breaks the language's syntax.
dsi:syntax/meta: Metadata or a meta-instruction in code or markup.
dsi:syntax/document-meta: Metadata that applies to a whole document.
dsi:syntax/annotation: Metadata that annotates or adds attributes to a code element.
dsi:syntax/processing-instruction: A processing instruction or preprocessor directive.
dsi:syntax/definition: A modifier marking the place where a name is defined, as opposed to used.
dsi:syntax/constant: A modifier marking a name or value that does not change.
dsi:syntax/function: A modifier marking a name that refers to a function.
dsi:syntax/standard: A modifier marking a name that the language or its standard library provides.
dsi:syntax/local: A modifier marking a name visible only in its local scope.
dsi:syntax/special: A modifier marking a variant with special meaning, such as a special string.
dsi:syntax/variable: A group of roles for variables: variable names and their modified forms.
dsi:syntax/attribute: A group of roles for markup attributes: attribute names and values.
dsi:syntax/tag: A group of roles for markup tags: tag names and their brackets.
dsi:syntax/type: A group of roles for types: type names and type operators.
dsi:syntax/special-string: A string with special meaning, such as a template or pattern string.
